name: Aquila-T1 CSR Map v1.0
description: Control/status registers for a single Aquila-T1 accelerator tile (APB3). Addresses are byte-addressed.

registers.name: TILE_ID
registers.desc: Design identifier, revision, and feature bitmap.

registers.name: PART_A_MASK0
registers.desc: Activation bank partition mask (bit i selects bank i for A). For GB_BANKS ≤ 32.

registers.name: PART_W_MASK0
registers.desc: Weight bank partition mask (bit i selects bank i for W). For GB_BANKS ≤ 32.

registers.name: PART_C_MASK0
registers.desc: Output/partials bank partition mask (bit i selects bank i for C). For GB_BANKS ≤ 32.

registers.name: DOORBELL
registers.desc: Write-1-to-pulse (W1P) doorbell for work submission. Read returns zero.

registers.name: IRQ_MASK
registers.desc: Interrupt mask register for tile_irq aggregation (low-active mask not used; 1 permits interrupt class).
